fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 45 days present elevated risk with no offsetting smart money support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (215.5) indicates extreme market stress, and utilities face credit spread pressure; earnings in 45 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three aligned bullish crossovers (SMA 9/21 golden cross, Ichimoku TK cross, MACD 12/26/9) with price structure above intermediate MAs provide technical entry confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stochastic RSI, Williams %R), weak trend strength (ADX false), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 215.5), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 45 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
